errors.text: The proposed rare-earth addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of spark plasma sintering MgAlTiVFeCo at 1000 °C.
No Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy-alloy evidence supports the proposed Y or Ce addition; both cited studies concern compositionally and mechanistically different refractory alloys.
The hypothesis omits quantitative composition, additive concentration, processing temperature, exposure time, oxidation atmosphere, and corrosion-electrolyte boundaries.
The proposed mechanism is generic and does not identify densification or the AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 barrier phases central to the target mechanism.
Predictions are not quantitative and omit relative density, hardness, oxidation rate constants, corrosion potential, and corrosion current density.
The experiment lacks controlled REE dose, fixed processing conditions, defined test protocols, and numerical decision thresholds.
